notes.title: Several Bug Fixes! (Thank you all for reporting such detailed feedbacks)
notes.notes:
Hello guys,
Thank you so much for all the detailed feedback! Finally I managed to solve the problem that generated some expressions with errors!
It's all ok now!

notes.title: Bug fixes and more
notes.notes:
Helo everyone,

This little game has been an incredible journey! Very good feedback from players!
I focused on adjusting the most recurring requests. See what's changed:

[olist]
 Double "=" no longer crash the game;
 The following situations no longer occurred:

1 * N
N * 1
 1 ^ N
 N ^ 1

[/olist]

Please, if you find any recurrence of these problems, let me know through the forum ;)

Also, keep sending us your suggestions on how to make it even better!
